g.text: PX4 GNSS -> EKF: independent acquisition, IMU-driven fusion

text.tspan: GNSS arrival does not directly execute EKF2 in this path.
uORB retains the selected solution until an IMU-driven EKF2 Run() checks it.
Three times remain distinct: measurement time, publication/arrival time, and fusion time.
After EKF2 ingests a new GNSS solution, the estimator stores it in its own timestamped buffer.
The delayed fusion horizon decides when the observation is eligible for correction.
There is no separate GNSS-fusion thread concurrently modifying EKF state.
